info.name: ArtCraft Office
info.summary: Edit Office documents and PDFs in the browser with ArtCraft's Rust/WASM editors
info.description:
Open and edit **docx, xlsx, pptx and pdf** directly in Nextcloud using the open-source, Rust/WebAssembly editors from the ArtCraft project (WordCraft, GridCraft, DeckCraft, PdfCraft) — an OnlyOffice/Collabora-style experience, but fully self-contained: no document server, no Docker, no external service. Everything runs in the browser, same-origin with your Nextcloud session, so no document content ever leaves your server.
Features: - File actions and "New document" entries for docx / xlsx / pptx / pdf. - Embedded editor overlay in the web Files app (with "open in new tab / fullscreen"). - Registered as a Nextcloud editor (DirectEditing), so the mobile/desktop clients and "Open with" offer it too. - Saves back over WebDAV; recovery via Nextcloud file versions.
**Unofficial** — not affiliated with or endorsed by ArtCraft / storytold. The bundled editors are licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0 and are **alpha** software (imperfect fidelity; keep them updated).
info.author: Manuel Dell
